# bundle validate rejects missing musher.yaml and bad asset references

# no musher.yaml in empty directory
mkdir empty
cd empty
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle validate
stderr 'Invalid bundle definition'

# musher.yaml that references a non-existent asset file
mkdir badref
cd badref
cp $WORK/bad_musher.yaml musher.yaml
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle validate
stderr 'Validation failed'

-- bad_musher.yaml --
name: test-bundle
description: A test bundle with a missing asset
namespace: acme
slug: test-bundle
version: 0.1.0
assets:
  - id: missing-skill
    kind: skill
    src: does-not-exist/SKILL.md
